# Uniswap Api

Uniswap Trading API for executing swaps and managing liquidity across 25+ blockchain networks

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/uniswap-api/.

## Actions

- **Check Token Approval** (read-only): Check if a wallet has sufficient token approval for a specified transaction amount.
- **Check Wallet Delegation** (read-only): Get the current delegation status and message for a smart contract wallet across different chains.
- **Encode 7702 transactions** (read-only): Encode a list of transactions into a single transaction for smart contract wallet execution (EIP-7702).
- **Get Gasless Orders** (read-only): Retrieve one or more gasless orders from Uniswap, optionally filtered by query parameters.
- **Get Quote** (read-only): Requests a quote according to the specified swap parameters.
- **Get Swap Status** (read-only): Retrieve the current status of swap or bridge transactions on the Uniswap trading platform.
- **Get swappable tokens** (read-only): Returns the list of destination bridge chains for a given token on a given chain.
